# GoStudy

> > GoStudy is an international education consultancy helping students pursue degrees abroad with test prep (IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, GMAT, PTE), university admissions, and visa assistance.

GoStudy operates offices across the Middle East, Asia, and India, specializing in study abroad programs to destinations including Ireland, UK, USA, Netherlands, Germany, Poland, and Australia. The consultancy provides comprehensive support from test preparation through visa processing, with expertise in Masters, MBA, and PhD program admissions.

## Key Topics

- IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, GMAT, PTE test preparation
- Study abroad consulting and university admissions
- Ireland education programs
- India education consulting
- International student scholarships
- Education loans and financial aid
- Masters degree (MS/MSc) programs
- MBA programs abroad
- PhD and doctorate programs
- Overseas education consultancy
- Student visa assistance
- Work permit and post-study opportunities
- SOP and LOR writing support
- Middle East consultancy offices (Doha, Dubai, Riyadh, Manama)
- Problem-based learning programs

- [Bachelors in Netherlands: Universities, Courses, Fees, Scholarships - Gostudy](https://www.go.study/bachelors-in-netherlands): BA/BSc/BEd programs in Netherlands with problem-based learning approach
